name: Montreal bilingual customer-success manager choosing SaaS employers

constraints: French-first search but English titles common
Wants customer success rather than generic support
context.company_awareness: Knows several Canadian SaaS brands but wants smaller employers too.

trigger: A promising French-language remote role turns out to require residence in France, prompting a more geographically precise search.

searches_run.query: gestionnaire succès client SaaS Montréal télétravail
searches_run.observation: Retrieved French and English customer-success titles, employer pages and aggregators. Petal uses a French title while Fourwaves uses English, supporting a bilingual title strategy rather than French-only posting filters.

searches_run.query: customer success manager remote Canada Quebec bilingual French jobs
searches_run.observation: Results included explicit Quebec-only and Canada-remote roles. Direct Fourwaves inspection says Canada remote but also near Quebec City, showing that even country/province matches may leave a proximity requirement to clarify.

sources.title: Customer success manager | Fourwaves
sources.supports: Direct employer page says SaaS, Canada remote, French/English fluency and near Quebec City; exact Montreal compatibility should be confirmed.

sources.title: Gestionnaire de réussite client digital | Petal
sources.supports: Retrieved French posting title and remote designation; SaaS-health responsibilities appear in snippet.

sources.title: Bilingual French Senior Customer Success Manager | Applied Systems
sources.supports: Retrieved employer snippet explicitly specifies remote within Quebec and French/English requirements.

best_entry_page.primary_query: entreprises SaaS Québec emplois succès client télétravail
best_entry_page.promise: Discover covered SaaS employers and compare bilingual customer-success openings with explicit Canadian or Quebec remote scope.
best_entry_page.cta: Follow selected employers using French and English title variants.
proof_needed: Country/province and proximity restrictions from sources
Do not confuse posting language with required language
Relevant customer-success scope versus support or sales-only duties

conversion_objections: French search results often lead to Europe.
English titles can still require French.
Remote Canada may carry province or office-distance restrictions.
Customer success can mean support tickets or sales quota under another label.

avoid_targeting.query: tous les emplois télétravail francophones monde
avoid_targeting.reason: Global French-speaking roles are broader than this geographic need and all-coverage is unverified.
Remote permission must come from individual postings.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Je cherche en français, mais je ne veux pas perdre les offres au titre anglais. Mon critère est de pouvoir travailler depuis Montréal; montrez-moi le territoire permis et les éventuelles contraintes de proximité, pas seulement le mot télétravail.

confidence_and_limits: Synthetic simulation, not an interview or an independent respondent. Two queries retrieved on 2026-09-28, with at least one direct page inspection. Queries without observed source IDs are hypotheses. Combined retrieval is not a controlled ranking report. No volume, difficulty or conversion inference. Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
